name: Worsel
source:
Member of "The Six". Previously a professional gambler in Las Vegas.  Possesses the power of pyrokinesis.

His lack of professionalism and thrill-seeking personality frequently put him at odds with Clarissa and Nadreck. After manifesting his pyrokinesis powers, he was scouted by Kinnison and works under his team. His intrinsic love of gambling is fulfilled by the risks he frequently incurs as part of his job.

Like Kamori, he is capable of manipulating fire. However his training and experience far exceed hers and he is capable of manipulating the oxygen levels of an environment to better fuel his flames.

[Spoiler] He has partial Native-American heritage but is dismissive of Bågenholm and her unwillingness to exploit her powers to their full potential. Although lazy with the administrative aspects of his job, he is more than willing to risk his life to eliminate a target.

He is killed by Nao during their duel in Kamori's route but survives in the other two routes. [/Spoiler]
